After transferFrom is called, the spender's allowance from the from-address strictly decreases by the transferred amount.

After a successful transferFrom by spender S pulling amount A from owner O to any recipient, a subsequent transferFrom by the same spender S is only allowed up to the remaining allowance (i.e. allowance is decreased by the first transfer), so performing a second transferFrom of the same amount will revert if original allowance equaled the first amount.
After a successful transferFrom that did not revert, the allowance reported by allowance(from, spender) is strictly less than it was before the call.
